topic: What miners change to get a new hash: the nonce
title: What Is a Nonce in Bitcoin Mining?
hook: Miners keep changing one tiny number. Here is why.

scenes.narration: Hash the same block header twice and you get the same answer, so a miner has to change something to try again.
The block header has an easy-to-modify nonce field. Changing it gives a brand new hash to test.
Each new hash is compared with the network target. If it does not exceed it, the block is valid proof of work.

cta: Curious how digital mining fits in? The link is in the description.
description_body: The nonce is the field miners adjust to produce new hashes until one meets the network target.
